description: The paginated lists never tell the client that more results are available: the 'has next page' flag is always false even when the returned page is completely full and more records exist, so our infinite scroll stops after the first batch.
data_flow: UsersController.findAll passes the fetched page and {page, limit} to infinityPagination, which derives hasNextPage from data.length compared to limit
A page can never contain more than limit rows, so a strict greater-than comparison is always false
notes: Single util used by the users list endpoint. The service and repository return correct rows; only the flag is wrong.
